title: HumanitZ
provenance: Reported by frogkochapon (highball#95, 2026-09-14), Apple M5 Pro, macOS 26.6.2, Highball 0.9.11, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r2. Crashed on DXMT, then reached the main menu on DXVK. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Unreal Engine 4, DirectX 11. Use D3DMetal, set by the recipe. On DXMT the game dies at start with an Unreal fatal error, CreateTexture2D failed with E_FAIL for a 1000x1000 R8G8 texture flagged D3D11_RESOURCE_MISC_SHARED, which DXMT cannot create. On DXVK it reaches the menu but the reporter found the game far too dark to play. On D3DMetal the maintainer ran the free demo (Steam 1773210) through the menus, character creation and the spawn picker with lit 3D backdrops at 45 to 57 fps fullscreen at 1728x1117 on an M1 Pro; gameplay past the spawn is not measured here yet. On engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r6 (D3DMetal from GPTK 4.0 beta 2, macOS 27 only) the demo's menu ran stable for three minutes at about a fifth to a half of r5's resident memory (260 to 700 MB against 1.26 GB) with the same GPU load; measured blind on 2026-09-19 (session locked: process, GPU load and logs, no captures), so the picture itself is not confirmed yet. Frame generation (engine r7 or later, off by default) was measured on it here on 2026-09-22, M1 Pro, macOS 27, D3DMetal at 1728x1117 on a 120 Hz display: the same spot in gameplay presents about 47 fps with it off and 63 to 74 at 2x, and it felt smooth to play, moving around.

knownIssues.symptom: On DXMT the game crashes at start with "Direct3DDevice->CreateTexture2D failed with error E_FAIL", MiscFlags 0x2 (reported on an M5 Pro)
knownIssues.cause: reported crash text: Unreal asks for a texture shared between processes and DXMT does not support shared resources
knownIssues.fix: D3DMetal (or DXVK), set by the recipe

knownIssues.symptom: On DXVK the menu draws but the game is very dark, characters and terrain barely visible (reported on an M5 Pro)
knownIssues.cause: not measured, a lighting problem on the DXVK path; D3DMetal lights the same scenes
knownIssues.fix: D3DMetal, set by the recipe from 2026-09-17

verified.fps: about 45 to 57 in the menus and spawn picker at 1728x1117 fullscreen, free demo, gameplay not exercised
